KABA 7104 Simplex Keypad Gate Lock

The KABA Simplex 7104 heavy duty mechanical pushbutton keypad deadlatch lock set. Deadlocking Latch - Unlock door/gate with the pushbutton keypad from the outside. Ideal for locations with frequent personal turnover - no keys required. Easy to install, program and maintain.

Use on doors such as swimming pool gates, house/building entry gates, utility room doors, where self latching is required. Automatically re-locks each time the door closes. Unlock door from exterior with single access combination code while allowing free egress at all times by interior thumbturn.

Other Simplex 7100 Series Models: KABA Simplex Keypad Deadbolt Lock

Features of the KABA Simplex 7104

  • Easy to maintain - no batteries to replace.
  • Durable heavy-duty construction.
  • Automatic relock
  • Single access code—one easy to manage code for all users
  • Easily programmed via keypad without removing lock from the door
  • Highly weather resistant

Specifications of KABA Simplex 7104

  • Construction: All metal cast front housing. Force-proof clutch protected exterior thumbturn.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 2-1/4"
  • Minimum Stile: 4"
  • Installation: Easily installs on wood or metal doors/gates. 1-3/8" diameter through bore for housing; 3/4" diameter for combination change. 1" diameter cross bore for latch.
  • Backset: Adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Latch: 1/2" deadlocking latch with flat front faceplate.
  • Strike: Curved lip strike plate.
  • Handing: Non-handed, field reversible.
  • Numeric Keypad: Vandal resistant, mechanical 5 button keypad.
  • Warranty: One (1) Year.
